## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Santa Ana, United States. It starts at 100 Aquarium Way, Long Beach.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Take a journey of discovery through the world's largest ocean at the Aquarium of the Pacific in Long Beach. Meet over 12,000 animals and see over 100 exhibits in sunny Southern California, the Northern Pacific's frigid waters, and the Tropical Pacific's colorful reefs.
>
> Discover all our exhibits including sea otters, penguins, sharks, sea jellies, green sea turtles, and more.

## Price and rating
